summary: The install now completes in a fresh subscription.

fixes.title: Install goes on in a new subscription
fixes.text: In a subscription never used for SecurityInsight's kind of jobs, the install no longer stops at the capacity check. Capacity is checked when the environment is created.

fixes.title: A second install run signs you in
fixes.text: Running the install again in the same window signs you in again instead of stopping at the subscription check.
